{"title":"Microsoft Azure","summary":"For AZ-900 first: the concepts, services and tools of Azure. Six guided projects are done in your own Azure account, which you clean up afterwards so they cost nothing or close to it."}

{"title":"Account failover","body":"GRS and GZRS keep a copy in a secondary region, so the data is durable if the primary is lost. Writing to it again needs an account failover, and reading from it without one needs RA-GRS or RA-GZRS.","sources":[{"title":"Data redundancy, Azure Storage (Microsoft Learn)","url":"https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-redundancy"}]}

{"title":"Rehydration","body":"A blob in the archive tier can't be read or changed. It has to be rehydrated to the hot, cool or cold tier first, which can take up to 15 hours.","sources":[{"title":"Access tiers for blob data (Microsoft Learn)","url":"https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/access-tiers-overview"}]}
{"title":"Host a static website from Blob Storage","brief":"Turn on static website hosting in a storage account, publish a page, change it, and clean up."}
{"title":"Give a new employee least-privilege access","brief":"Create a user and a group in Microsoft Entra ID, grant the group a role on one resource group, and check it can do no more."}
{"title":"Serve an endpoint with Azure Functions","brief":"Create a function app on a consumption plan with an HTTP-triggered function, call it, and read its logs."}
{"title":"Tag resources and lock them","brief":"Tag resources for cost tracking, put a delete lock on them, prove the lock stops a deletion, then remove it."}
{"title":"Set up cost guardrails","brief":"Tag for cost tracking, create a budget with alerts, and assign a policy that rejects resources breaking a rule."}
{"title":"Manage resources from Cloud Shell","brief":"Create, list, tag and query resources with az commands in Cloud Shell, formatting and filtering the output."}

{"title":"The Azure CLI","summary":"Ten az commands, each missing the flag that makes it do the job. Run them in Cloud Shell or a terminal you're signed in to; the guided project for the CLI walks through most of them."}
{"clue":"A resource group tagged as a development one"}
{"clue":"A lock that stops the resource group being deleted"}
{"clue":"A Linux virtual machine from a marketplace image"}
{"clue":"A storage account whose data is spread across availability zones"}
{"clue":"Make cool the account's default tier, for new blobs and for existing ones with no tier set"}
{"clue":"What happened to the resource group in the past week"}
{"clue":"Delete the resource group without being asked to confirm"}
{"title":"Cloud concepts","summary":"The models, service types and benefits the cloud is described with. Each tile gives a definition; the slip is the term."}
{"clue":"You rent servers, storage and networks, and manage the operating system yourself"}
{"clue":"You deploy your application; the provider manages the operating system and runtime"}
{"clue":"You use finished software over the internet, such as email or office apps"}
{"clue":"A provider's resources, shared by many customers over the internet"}
{"clue":"Cloud resources used by a single organization only"}
{"clue":"Public cloud and your own datacenter, working together as one environment"}
{"clue":"A pricing model: you're charged only for what you use, and stop paying when you stop using it"}
{"clue":"You run code without managing any servers, and are billed when it runs"}
{"clue":"Spending up front on physical infrastructure you then own"}
{"clue":"Ongoing spending with nothing paid up front, accounted for in the period it's spent"}
{"clue":"A service stays up despite failures, measured as uptime in an SLA"}
{"clue":"A system recovers from failures and keeps functioning"}
{"clue":"You can know in advance what performance and costs will be"}
{"clue":"Adding more instances, such as virtual machines, to share the load"}
{"clue":"Giving an existing virtual machine more CPU or memory"}
{"title":"Compute, hosting and moving data","summary":"Where an application can run in Azure, and the tools for moving files and servers into it."}
{"clue":"A group of identical virtual machines that scales out and in automatically"}
{"clue":"Spreads virtual machines across fault and update domains, so not all go down at once"}
{"clue":"Windows desktops and apps that run in Azure and are used from anywhere"}
{"clue":"Hosts web apps and APIs without you managing the servers underneath"}
{"clue":"Runs small pieces of code in response to events, such as an HTTP request or a timer"}
{"clue":"Runs a container on demand, without managing virtual machines"}
{"clue":"A command-line tool that copies blobs and files to or from a storage account"}
{"clue":"A desktop app for browsing and managing the data in storage accounts"}
{"clue":"Keeps Azure Files and Windows file servers in sync, with a cache kept on-premises"}
{"clue":"Discovers, assesses and moves on-premises servers, databases and apps to Azure"}
{"clue":"A physical device shipped to you, for moving large amounts of data offline"}
{"title":"Core architecture","summary":"How Azure is laid out physically and how resources are organized."}
{"clue":"Anything you create in Azure: a virtual machine, a database, a virtual network"}
{"clue":"A container for resources that share a lifecycle; each resource is in exactly one"}
{"clue":"A unit of billing and access control that holds resource groups"}
{"clue":"Groups subscriptions so that policies and access apply to all of them"}
{"clue":"A set of datacenters in one geographic area, connected by a low-latency network"}
{"clue":"Two regions in the same geography, at least 300 miles apart, updated one at a time"}
{"clue":"An instance of Azure isolated from the main one, for government or compliance needs"}
{"clue":"A physically separate location within a region, with its own power, cooling and networking"}
{"title":"Governance, management and monitoring","summary":"Keeping costs, rules and resources under control, and seeing what is happening."}
{"clue":"Enforces rules on resources, such as allowed regions, and reports what doesn't comply"}
{"clue":"Stops a resource from being deleted or changed by mistake"}
{"clue":"Name and value pairs on resources, used to organize them and group their costs"}
{"clue":"Discovers, classifies and governs data across your whole estate"}
{"clue":"Manages servers and Kubernetes clusters outside Azure from Azure"}
{"clue":"JSON files that declare the resources to deploy, so a deployment can be repeated"}
{"clue":"A shell in the browser with the Azure CLI and Azure PowerShell already set up"}
{"clue":"Personalized recommendations for reliability, security, performance and cost"}
{"clue":"Tells you about Azure incidents and planned maintenance that affect your resources"}
{"clue":"Collects metrics and logs from your resources and alerts on them"}
{"clue":"Where you write queries over the log data that monitoring collects"}
{"clue":"Monitors the performance and usage of a web application"}
{"clue":"Estimates what services will cost before you deploy them"}
{"clue":"Reports on what you have spent, and sets budgets with alerts"}
{"title":"Networking, identity and security","summary":"Connecting to Azure, and deciding who gets in and how they are protected."}
{"clue":"A private connection from your network to Azure that doesn't cross the public internet"}
{"clue":"Sends encrypted traffic between your network and Azure over the public internet"}
{"clue":"Hosts the name records of your domains on Azure's infrastructure"}
{"clue":"Connects two virtual networks so traffic between them stays on Microsoft's backbone"}
{"clue":"Gives a service a private IP address inside your virtual network"}
{"clue":"Microsoft's cloud identity service: users, groups and sign-in"}
{"clue":"One sign-in gives access to many applications"}
{"clue":"Sign-in asks for a second proof, such as a code on your phone"}
{"clue":"Signing in with Windows Hello, an authenticator app or a security key, with no password"}
{"clue":"Allows, blocks or challenges a sign-in based on signals such as location or device"}
{"clue":"Gives a user or group a role, such as Reader, at a scope such as a resource group"}
{"clue":"Assume breach, and verify every request explicitly, whatever network it comes from"}
{"clue":"Layers of protection, so that no single failure exposes the data"}
{"clue":"Assesses security posture and protects workloads in Azure, on-premises and other clouds"}
